description: Open a support ticket with the people behind AUTOGROK Desk (payment or receipt, a failed job, credits, anything else). Send X-Entitlement-Key on the connection or include an email. Returns a ticket id like HELP-XXXX. No automatic reply is sent; a person answers, usually within 1 business day.

email.description: Where to reply. Defaults to the pack's checkout email.

message.description: What happened, in a few sentences. Include a job id if you have one.

topic.description: payment = payment or receipt; job = a job failed or looks wrong; credits = credits or balance; other

name: support_request
title: Ask a person for help (free)
